method.slope: degrees, arctan of the metre-space gradient of the landform surface (DEM smoothed to 150 m)
method.zonal: mean over DEM cells whose centre falls inside the polygon
method.dsm_caveat: GLO-30 is a surface model: over closed palm canopy the raw gradient measures crowns, not ground. Raw surface slope averages 4.80 degrees here against 2.56 on the smoothed landform, on an estate with 29 m of relief across 12 km. slope_deg is the landform figure; surface_slope_deg is kept per block so the difference stays visible.
method.canopy_roughness: Standard deviation of the residual between the raw surface and the landform surface, in metres. A stand-uniformity proxy: gaps and uneven crowns raise it. Relative, not absolute - it also carries DEM noise.
method.note: The client supplies nothing for this layer. It is measured over their own block polygons from a public elevation model, exactly like the Sentinel-2 canopy layer.

summary.reading: Gently undulating: mean 2.7 degrees, steepest 5.5. Enough range to adjust quotas at the margin.
